node.title: Re^6: Getting the client IP in Apache, version 2.4
node.author: chris212
node.doctext: Yes, that is the first thing I tried. But none of the remote_* or client_* methods seem to be defined for Apache2::Connection. I could get useragent_ip, but I'm trying to use this to blacklist malicious users, and I suspect an attacker could spoof that easily.
